item.text: {"search_note":"I found no reliable 2024 evidence of a serious mis-handling of AI, cyber, or other catastrophic-risk domains on the scale of reckless deployment. I found no direct 2024 evidence on biological-risk policy, pathogen security, gene editing, or biosecurity transparency. The strongest limitation is process transparency: the 5G security decision was partly negotiated behind closed doors, so the record is more precautionary than openly transparent.","evidence":[{"title":"National Security Strategy","publisher":"Federal Government","date":"14 Jun 2023, still operative in 2024","url":"https://www.bundesregierung.de/breg-en/aktuelles/national-security-strategy-2196356","summary":"Scholz described Germany’s first National Security Strategy as a systematic, prevention-oriented approach that includes diplomacy, police, fire brigades, technical relief services, development cooperation, cyber security, and supply-chain resilience. It also explicitly mentions global pandemic prevention. This is the clearest background evidence for precaution in catastrophic-risk domains.","question_ids":["1B.9","1B.7"]},{"title":"Bundeskanzler Scholz zur aktuellen Sicherheitslage","publisher":"Bundesregierung","date":"6 Jun 2024","url":"https://www.bundesregierung.de/breg-de/service/newsletter-und-abos/bulletin/scholz-sicherheitslage-2291096","summary":"Scholz said German security authorities had carefully prepared for a high-risk summer and framed safety as a core state duty. This supports a cautious, institution-based handling of security risks rather than improvisation.","question_ids":["1B.9","1B.3","1B.7"]},{"title":"Germany to approve EU’s planned AI act","publisher":"Reuters","date":"30 Jan 2024","url":"https://www.investing.com/news/economy/germany-will-approve-eus-planned-ai-act--sources-3286730","summary":"Reuters reported that the German government settled its internal dispute and moved to approve the EU AI Act, after a compromise that would preserve “trustworthy AI” while remaining innovation-friendly. This is good evidence that Scholz’s government handled AI regulation with precaution rather than deregulatory haste.","question_ids":["1B.9"]},{"title":"Germany agrees phaseout of Huawei, ZTE components in 5G core network","publisher":"Reuters","date":"11 Jul 2024","url":"https://www.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/DEUTSCHE-TELEKOM-AG-444661/news/Germany-agrees-phaseout-of-Huawei-ZTE-components-in-5G-core-network-47361811/","summary":"Reuters reported that Germany completed contracts to remove Huawei and ZTE components from 5G core networks after 2026, with further network elements to be replaced by 2029. This is strong precautionary handling of dual-use digital infrastructure.","question_ids":["1B.9"]},{"title":"Rede von Bundeskanzler Olaf Scholz","publisher":"Bundesregierung","date":"13 Oct 2024","url":"https://www.bundesregierung.de/breg-de/service/newsletter-und-abos/bulletin/rede-von-bundeskanzler-olaf-scholz-2307122","summary":"Scholz said AI risks must not be ignored and argued that the EU AI Act creates a safer environment and stronger user trust. He also tied 5G security to removing critical components from high-risk networks on a fixed timetable. This is direct evidence of precaution plus a regulatory frame.","question_ids":["1B.9","1B.7"]},{"title":"Insider - Regierung entscheidet \"in Kürze\" über Sicherheit im 5G-Netz","publisher":"Reuters","date":"23 May 2024","url":"https://www.onvista.de/news/2024/05-23-bericht-regierung-vertagt-entscheidung-ueber-strengere-vorschriften-im-5g-netz-0-20-26275293","summary":"Reuters reported that the 5G security decision was handled through confidential interministerial talks, and the ministries declined public comment because of agreed confidentiality. This is the main transparency counterweight: the policy direction was precautionary, but the process was not fully transparent in real time.","question_ids":["1B.9"]}]}
